summary: Implemented rich.progress.open, rich.progress.wrap_file, and Progress.open/Progress.wrap_file per the spec. Changes are additive only, in rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py (20 new tests), docs/source/progress.rst (two subsections), and CHANGELOG.md (one bullet linking PR 1759). Nothing committed. Tests, black, and mypy were not run, per instructions, so the changes are verified by reading only. Choices to review: the reader also defines name, mode (delegating to the handle) and truncate (raising UnsupportedOperation), since typing.BinaryIO's abstract members would otherwise block instantiation; the context wrapper stops the Progress if entering the reader fails; only the spec-listed type-ignore comments were added.
